views.name: chunk_view_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T2."team_api_id"
FROM Team AS T2
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA1
  ON T2."team_api_id" = TA1."team_api_id"
WHERE
  TA1."team_fifa_api_id" = 434
views.description:
Task: Identify the player with the maximum overall rating and return their API ID.
Required outputs: The API ID of the player with the highest overall rating.
validated_on: Which league had the most goals in the 2016 season?

views.name: chunk_view_2
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "home_player_X1"
FROM "Match"
ORDER BY
  "B365H" DESC
LIMIT 1
